name: Zerochan
description: Zerochan (anime images), read-only API: RSS listing + one request per downloaded post, 10 s apart (robots.txt). Public posts only (no login), the 10,000 newest posts of a search at most. Zerochan asks API clients for a User-Agent with the project name and YOUR Zerochan username, or they may be banned: set it in Settings → Kết nối → "Headers theo site (JSON)": {"zc": {"User-Agent": "Lynxx - <your username>"}}. Tags: one per website query (Hatsune_Miku); more tags and -tags are checked locally.
